name: "Sloppy Joe" Beef Bowl with Sweet Potatoes, Cabbage & Pickled Onion

instructions.primary_message: Place vinegar, honey, and salt in a small bowl; stir to combine the pickling liquid.
Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the pickling liquid, stir to combine, and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
340 g sweet potato
½ small head red cabbage
½ jalapeño pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel and medium dice sweet potato. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, then drizzle with oil and season with spices. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp parsley flakes
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until sweet potato is fork-tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, honey, and spices in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
apple cider vinegar
honey
½ tsp garlic powder
salt
black pepper
⅛ tsp cayenne pepper

instructions.primary_message: Halve cabbage lengthwise, cut out the core, and slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl with the dressing, toss to coat, and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

While the skillet heats up, thinly slice jalapeño pepper into rings; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Set aside. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Once the skillet is hot, add beef and salt; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
Add water, ketchup, Dijon, vinegar, and spices to the skillet, then stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce has thickened slightly, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp ketchup
1 tsp Dijon mustard
apple cider vinegar
½ tsp smoked paprika
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide sweet potatoes, cabbage, and beef between bowls. Top with jalapeños and pickled onions. Enjoy!
